title: Mr C Residences underline link
description: A text link with a 1px underline drawn under it. In 'shrink' mode the line is there at rest and draws back to the right on hover, then regrows from the left; in 'grow' mode it is hidden at rest and draws in from the left on hover.
notes: the line is currentColor, so it follows the text colour
set type size, weight and tracking with className; lineClassName moves the line (default 4px under the text)
name: mrcresidencesbocaraton-underline-link

props.name: behaviour
props.description: shrink: line at rest, draws back on hover. grow: no line at rest, draws in on hover

props.name: duration
props.description: the line's duration in ms (the original uses 500 for content links, 300 for the nav)

props.name: lineClassName
props.description: classes for the line itself (position, thickness)
